|translation='''Title:''' R4-E1 (Arfour-Eeone).

'''Card text:''' Deploy only on a vehicle (except a creature vehicle). Power, maneuver, and landspeed +1. May remain aboard and move the vehicle with no other personnel. Has no astromech capability.

'''Lore:''' A vehicle computer droid by Industrial Automaton. This unit, R4-E1, accompanies BoShek. Reckless and fiercely independent.
